# KayKit Adventurers

Selected models from [KayKit Adventurers](https://kaylousberg.itch.io/kaykit-adventurers) provide the Warrior (`Knight.fbx`), basic enemy (`Rogue.fbx`), and boss placeholder (`Barbarian.fbx`).

The included [license](License.txt) is CC0. Preserve it and the [asset license manifest](../../Licenses/ASSET_LICENSES.md). Import only assets needed by the playable slice; inactive variants are recorded in the [archive manifest](../../_Archive/ARCHIVE_MANIFEST.md).

Use project visual wrappers rather than adding gameplay behavior to imported models.
